question: 11 July is observed as ______ every year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**world population day**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• World Population Day 

 
 
• **World Population Day aims to increase people's awareness of various population issues such as the importance of family planning, gender equality, poverty, maternal health and human rights.** 
 
• By** resolution 45/216 of December 1990,** the United Nations General Assembly decided to continue observing World Population Day to **enhance awareness of population issues.**
 
• The Day was first marked on **11 July 1990 **in more than **90 countries.**
